Six open textbooks, free to read online. Written with
[bookdown](https://bookdown.org/) and hosted on
[Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/). Every title can also be
downloaded as a PDF or ePub.

## Learning path {#path}

The Core Track is designed to be followed end to end. The two companions slot
in alongside it rather than after it.

::: {.lpath}

::: {.lstep}
<span class="num">Core 01</span>

### Intro to R

<p><span class="lpill beg">Beginner</span>Zero to running code. RStudio, packages, help.</p>
:::

::: {.lstep}
<span class="num">Core 02</span>

### Data Wrangling

<p><span class="lpill beg">Beginner</span>Import, reshape, dplyr, pipes, tibbles.</p>
:::

::: {.lstep}
<span class="num">Core 03</span>

### Viz with ggplot2

<p><span class="lpill int">Intermediate</span>Grammar of graphics through to publication polish.</p>
:::

::: {.lstep}
<span class="num">Core 04</span>

### R, Databases & SQL

<p><span class="lpill int">Intermediate</span>DBI, dbplyr, queries, joins.</p>

<span class="lshortcut"><b>Shortcut:</b> already wrangling data in SQL? Take 04 straight after 02.</span>
:::

:::

::: {.lcomps}

::: {.lcomp}
<span class="num">Companion A — Foundational Tooling</span>

### Command Line Basics

<p><span class="lpill beg">Beginner</span>Files, permissions, pipes and scripting for R users. Pair with Core 01.</p>

<p><b>On Windows:</b> everything works from the RStudio Terminal, Git Bash or WSL — chapter 1 covers all three.</p>
:::

::: {.lcomp .deep}
<span class="num">Companion B — Graphics Deep-Dive</span>

### Data Viz with Base R

<p><span class="lpill int">Intermediate</span>Base graphics engine, parameters, multi-panel layouts, production export. Zero dependencies. After Core 03.</p>
:::

:::
